text:
mia: Heads-up — FinRegCo wants per-tenant geo-containment + opt-out for a small set of workloads. Need a concise gating playbook to attach to the quote.

alex: Clarify: hardware isolation vs region-locked routing vs logical controls? Tradeoffs matter for timeline/cost.

sam: Ops: fastest is region-locked routing + tenant slices. Dedicated hardware = procurement lead time.

rachel: SRE: require safety + recovery + stability gates. Suggest failover <45s in chaos sim and 7d stability window.

jenna: Legal: opt-out requires a timeboxed Pilot Exemption and a Risk Acceptance Appendix for permanent opt-outs.

marco: Sales: customer will pay uplift but wants firm milestones (pilot ~8w). Procurement may add 2-3w.

mia: Draft gate matrix (POC->CANARY->STAGED->GA) with owners. Quick cut: POC: routing tags + cache separation tests (eng-runtime). CANARY: 5 tenants + chaos sim (eng-platform/eng-sre). STAGED: 25 tenants, perf & legal artifacts (product/legal). GA: contract signoff + billing model (finance/product).

alex: Add explicit tests: prefix-blacklist, KV eviction, tenant-nonce to detect leakage.

sam: Capacity: reserve 1.8-2x baseline for failover headroom. Ops runbook required.

rachel: Monitoring: tenant-scoped drift detection, metrics = failover_time, routed_region, error_rate_by_tenant. Automated rollback on cross-routing detection.

jenna: Artifacts needed: data flow diagram, KMS policy, audit log retention, signed attestation, RAA.

marco: Billing ask: separate 'failover_compute' line item — propose measuring extra vGPU-seconds during failover. Finance to confirm metric.

mia: Owners & ETAs: alex (arch draft, 4d), sam (capacity+runbook, 3d), rachel (SLO+chaos, 2d), jenna (RAA+artifacts, 3d), marco (customer timeline, today).

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Geo-containment gating review" in 48h.

mia: I'll assemble the acceptance checklist from these items and attach to the quote.

alex: I'll include enforcement points (ingest, model cache, logs, backups) in the draft.

sam: Ops will add ACLs for tenant-scoped diagnostics.

rachel: I'll prepare dashboards and the automated alert/runbook.

jenna: I'll produce clause snippets for the SOW/RAA.

marco: I'll confirm billing preference with customer and share back.

mia: Thanks — aim to close POC verification in ~3 weeks so staged pilot timeline holds.
